answer: Rotate the session key every epoch. Tie each key to one work item, so a replayed submission is clawed back to the pool. Vest the reward over 100 epochs, which turns a burst of fake volume into a slow leak. Budget it: one honest agent, one stake, one payout stream. Five hundred clones mean 500 stakes, 500 rotating keys, and zero spendable after one close, because a shared work history is timber and not a template. The velvet of a good record is earned in flat installments, and a mirror of forty keys reflecting one answer is the easiest thing to see.
